However, two minor artifacts persist: (1) A faint, illegible text string/watermark in the bottom-left corner, likely dataset leakage or generation noise. (2) The white heart-shaped marking on the left horse's forehead exhibits slightly soft, painterly edges rather than crisp hair follicle separation, blending unnaturally into the purple fur. The perceptual quality auditor flagged a 'darken' distortion (severity 0.6), which aligns with the heavy purple color grading reducing perceived brightness/exposure. These are minor issues that do not compromise the overall realism of the subjects.
